draft.threads_post:
Chinese physical AI startup Simplexity Robotics is now valued at $1.6 billion after its pre-Series A round.

Ant Group led the $100 million funding round. Tech giants Alibaba and Tencent also joined the investment.

Will Chinese tech giants lead physical AI, or will US rivals stay ahead?
